storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP GoKollab DL makes it easy to save course materials from GoKollab and GoHighLevel-powered membership portals.

How it works: Navigate to any course page on your GoKollab portal, click the extension icon, and the popup shows all detected videos, images, GIFs, and text on the page. Pick what you want to download or use "Download Visible" to grab everything at once.

The extension automatically detects videos embedded from Loom, YouTube, Vimeo, Wistia, and GoHighLevel's native player. It handles HLS streaming, platform API extraction, and format conversion in your browser — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required.

Key features:
- Multi-platform video detection — Loom, YouTube, Vimeo, Wistia, GoHighLevel native, Circle
- Asset tabs for Videos, Images/GIFs, and Text on the current page
- "Download Visible" button for bulk downloading all assets at once
- Quality selection for supported video platforms
- In-page download manager with real-time progress
- Intelligent platform gating — only activates on GoKollab/HighLevel pages
- HLS-to-MP4 conversion handled automatically in your browser
- Dark-themed UI with sky blue accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Navigate to your GoKollab course page
3. Click the extension icon to scan the page
4. Select assets and download — videos save as MP4, images as their original format

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, and more.

faq.question: How do I download a video from my GoKollab course?
faq.answer: Go to the course page, click the extension icon, and the popup will show detected videos. Click any video to download, or use "Download Visible" to get everything on the page.

faq.question: What video platforms are supported?
faq.answer: The extension detects videos from Loom, YouTube, Vimeo, Wistia, GoHighLevel's native player, and Circle. It automatically identifies which platform is used.

faq.question: Does this work on any website?
faq.answer: No. The extension uses intelligent platform gating and only activates on GoKollab and GoHighLevel-powered client portals. It checks for specific HighLevel platform markers before running.

faq.question: Can I download images and text too?
faq.answer: Yes. The popup has three tabs — Videos, Images/GIFs, and Text. You can download assets from any tab individually or use the bulk download button.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: Videos are typically saved as MP4 files. The exact format depends on the source platform and selected quality.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: The extension is built for Chromium-based browsers — Chrome, Edge, Brave, and Opera. Firefox support may vary.

faq.question: Why doesn't the extension detect anything on my page?
faq.answer: The extension only activates on GoKollab/GoHighLevel pages. If you're on a different platform, it won't scan. If you are on the right platform, try pressing play on any video first, then click Rescan.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. All video processing happens locally in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
